items.stem: A leading indicator of safety performance is best illustrated by:

options.text: Percentage of planned safety inspections completed on time
options.rationale: Correct: completed inspections are a proactive leading measure.

options.text: Number of lost-time injuries last year

options.rationale: Claims cost is a lagging outcome.

options.text: Days since the last recordable injury
options.rationale: That is a lagging, after-the-fact measure.

items.explanation: Correct: completed inspections are a proactive leading measure.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Rating a risk on consequence alone is flawed because it ignores:

options.text: How likely the harm is to occur
options.rationale: Correct: risk combines consequence and likelihood.

options.text: The colour of the hazard sign
options.rationale: Sign colour is not a risk dimension.
Job title is irrelevant to risk rating.
Time alone is not the missing dimension.

items.explanation: Correct: risk combines consequence and likelihood.

items.stem: Select TWO components of a plan-do-check-act safety management system.

options.rationale: Correct: planning objectives and controls is the Plan stage.

options.text: Checking performance through audits and metrics (Check)
options.rationale: Correct: auditing and measuring is the Check stage.
Ignoring data is not part of PDCA.
Concealment is not part of a management system.

items.explanation: Correct: planning objectives and controls is the Plan stage. Correct: auditing and measuring is the Check stage.
